Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP4-Local — Abliterated
Community derivative published by DevelopingDad (https://huggingface.co/DevelopingDad).
Release of October 22, 2026.

Licensed by NVIDIA Corporation under the NVIDIA Open Model Agreement.

This repository contains a modified version of nvidia/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local
(revision b9ce18a6887e18c089fdea8509a33e63429a3300), which NVIDIA Corporation
derived from Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next. It is not made, endorsed or validated
by NVIDIA Corporation or by Qwen.

Licenses
- NVIDIA Open Model Agreement: LICENSE (copy of the agreement) and
  https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/agreements/enterprise-software/nvidia-open-model-agreement/
- Qwen Community License 1.0, Copyright (c) 2026 Qwen: upstream/QWEN-LICENSE
- NVIDIA's original model card: upstream/NVIDIA-README.md
The base weights are not relicensed. Copyright and upstream notices remain
with their respective owners.

Modifications
Refusal-direction ablation (trial 117 of a Heretic-style search) was baked
into the 48 attention output projections and the routed and shared expert
down projections. All modified tensors keep the base checkpoint's formats:
NVFP4 routed experts, and MXFP8 attention output projections and shared
experts. Other weights, the configuration, tokenizer, chat template and the
built-in MTP layer are NVIDIA's. Details are in README.md and provenance.json.

Third-party work this release builds on
- Qwen3.8-Flash-Next by Qwen (Qwen Community License 1.0).
- Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP4-Local by NVIDIA Corporation, quantized with NVIDIA
  Model Optimizer (NVIDIA Open Model Agreement).
- Method: "Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction",
  Arditi et al., 2024 (arXiv:2406.11717); and Heretic by Philipp Emanuel
  Weidmann and contributors (https://github.com/p-e-w/heretic, AGPL-3.0),
  whose parameterization this release reimplemented. No Heretic code is
  included in this repository.
- Prompt sets used to compute directions and measure refusals:
  mlabonne/harmful_behaviors (revision 01cead01398926d81f7c52bdb790ee8cf77ebba7),
  derived from AdvBench (llm-attacks, MIT); and mlabonne/harmless_alpaca
  (revision 02c6a92cfcf11bb0c387334f8146d149d65b587f), derived from
  tatsu-lab/alpaca (CC BY-NC 4.0). Neither prompt set is redistributed here.
- Software used to build and serve it: vLLM (Apache-2.0), FlashInfer and the
  B12X kernels by Local Inference Lab (Apache-2.0), Optuna (MIT), PyTorch
  (BSD-3-Clause), safetensors (Apache-2.0), and the
  eugr/spark-vllm-b12x container built from eugr/spark-vllm-docker (MIT).
  None of these is redistributed here; each keeps its own license.
